analysis.failures: retain full denominator; unscored preference pairs count incorrect; also report conditional coverage

cohort.decode: all native frames; cogvideo originals are GIF, no transcoding

development: Run dev only until candidate and numeric gates are frozen; original subject-source 34-base region dataset is diagnostic only, never official background holdout.
foreground_classes: all 19 movable COCO classes in shared foreground adapter, no prompt or label dependency
parity: compare exact tensor adapter with pinned upstream background_consistency on the same local checkpoint and actual original video; tolerance 1e-6

representation.missing_background: pair contributes zero at fixed time denominator
representation.missing_foreground: empty mask; no interpolation; report detected fraction
representation.union: spatial OR of all foreground masks within the same actual clip, repeated across time

selection: On dev, retain all methods. Rank candidates meeting natural accuracy >= official-0.02 and sensitivity checks by nuisance MAE; freeze selected parameters and protocol before any test scoring. Failure of every candidate requires a new recorded development revision, not test tuning.
supersedes: v1 run exposed 665/680 missing paths from the frozen E0 mapping; resolve shared media only. Labels, splits, methods and thresholds are unchanged. The 15 completed dev rows and every failed row remain archived.
